title: Assess IPO readiness and public-company operations
summary: When the board considers whether a public listing could be an appropriate financing or liquidity route. A board-reviewed readiness and go-or-no-go decision with a specialist-owned execution and operating plan.
outcomes: A board-reviewed readiness and go-or-no-go decision with a specialist-owned execution and operating plan.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the board considers whether a public listing could be an appropriate financing or liquidity route.

parts.title: Define the objective and readiness baseline
parts.guidance: Record financing and liquidity goals, financial history, ownership, controls, product risks and management capacity. Distinguish a readiness assessment from launching an offering or promising a listing date.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Select the market and qualified advisers
parts.guidance: The board and securities counsel assess suitable jurisdictions, venues, eligibility and alternatives. Appoint appropriately qualified financial, audit and legal advisers and confirm conflicts and engagement scope.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Select the market and qualified advisers

parts.title: Build the readiness gap and evidence register
parts.guidance: Reconcile audited financials, governance, equity, controls, disclosures and public-company reporting capability. Assign gaps and evidence owners and document assumptions that depend on the chosen market or transaction route.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve remediation and ongoing operating capacity
parts.guidance: Leadership agrees the budget, governance changes, reporting controls and staffing needed before a launch decision. Qualified reviewers determine required filings, communications controls and approvals for the selected route.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve remediation and ongoing operating capacity

parts.title: Decide whether to proceed and authorize the next stage
parts.guidance: The board reviews readiness, market conditions, costs and alternatives with advisers. Authorize a separately scoped transaction only when required, keeping any offering, disclosure or filing within its specialist-led approval process.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Decide whether to proceed and authorize the next stage

verify.how: A board-reviewed readiness and go-or-no-go decision with a specialist-owned execution and operating plan.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
